title: Create one high-quality photographic por
prompt:
Create one high-quality photographic portrait of a new fictional, clearly adult 22-year-old Korean woman (East Asian), outdoors on a grassy city overlook at dusk. Vertical 2:3 composition, framed from just above the crown to the upper thighs. The woman dominates the photograph; retain both complete hands and the expressive shape of her elbows while allowing the surroundings to remain secondary. The feeling is a lightly playful, close personal snapshot with an understated vintage film character.

She leans slightly forward toward the camera, with a relaxed diagonal shoulder line. Her face turns almost directly toward the lens, chin subtly lifted, eyes meeting the viewer. Her expression carries a small genuine smile, lips slightly parted with a restrained glimpse of upper teeth. One hand, on the viewer's left, is raised beside the mouth: the thumb and index finger form a loose small curve near the corner of the lips, the remaining fingers naturally relaxed. The fingertips do not obscure the eyes or push inside the mouth. Her other hand rests against the side of her waist on the viewer's right, elbow extending outward; that hand's fingers spread gently against the dress with believable joints. These two gestures and the forward lean must work together as one comfortable pose, with no stiff mannequin posture or extra fingers.

Give her a distinctive mature elongated oval face, a lightly defined jaw and softly tapered chin. Her eyes are narrow almond-shaped with naturally relaxed upper lids, eyebrows fairly straight and delicately unequal, the nose bridge long and straight with a softly rounded tip, and the lips moderately wide with a defined upper lip and fuller lower lip in a warm red tint. Preserve subtle adult facial asymmetry and realistic proportions. She is a distinct new individual, not a generic doll-faced model. Light Korean-inspired makeup, soft cheek warmth, fine skin microtexture, natural lashes, and gently luminous skin. Do not inflate the eyes, smooth away the entire skin surface, or apply an icy white complexion.

Her near-center-parted black hair falls straight and loosely to the upper chest, slightly longer on one side, with irregular tapered ends and a few fine strands moving across the forehead. The two dark curtains frame her cheeks without covering her expression. Retain small flyaways and the natural separation of individual strands, with modest volume at the crown; no elaborate curls, bun or short bob.

She wears a pale peach-pink sleeveless wrap dress with thin straps and a tiny scattered ivory floral print with muted green stems. The overlapping bodice forms a natural V neckline, its opaque cloth covering the breasts completely without visible nipples or areolae. Preserve tasteful collarbone and upper-chest space without deepening the neckline or exaggerating body proportions. The dress follows a slender natural adult torso. A small tie at the viewer's right waist draws the fabric inward and creates fine oblique tension folds running across the waist and toward the hand. The skirt continues in an overlapping diagonal hem, revealing part of one upper thigh while reliably covering all intimate areas. The fabric is matte and lightweight but fully opaque, with consistent floral scale and convincing seams, overlap and fold directions. The silhouette must emerge from her lean, the wrap construction and the hand at her waist, not from artificial curves or excessive body retouching.

The background consists of a gently descending dark green lawn, a few very small indistinct people far away, soft low city buildings, and a distant wooded ridge. A slender observation-tower silhouette rises on the viewer's right behind her head, blurred and secondary. Above it is a muted pink-lilac evening sky. Avoid making a tourism postcard or adding a written location. Include no signage, readable lettering, caption or invented city name. A small corner of a pale picnic blanket may enter the lower right edge, without becoming an additional subject.

Use soft, near-axis fill flash that brings her face, red lips and the peach dress forward against the darker ambient landscape. Keep a luminous highlight on the cheek, a gentle shadow beneath the jaw and collarbones, and realistic variation across the skin. The dusk background remains cool and subdued while the face retains warm natural color. Fine film grain and a faint warm amber light leak along the extreme right edge give a casual analog-photo feeling; keep this subtle and do not cover the face, hands or garment with heavy scratches. Natural lens perspective, approximately eye-level framing with a slight downward sense from her lean, sharp eyes and facial detail, softly falling background focus. Balance the dark vertical hair with the pale wrap dress, the small curved gesture at her mouth with the wider arm at her waist, and the warm person with the cool dusk. Recompose naturally into an exact 2:3 vertical frame without stretching, cropping off hands, or adding excessive sky. No watermark, logo, border, split panel, exaggerated anatomy or extra foreground person.
